image_description: A rooster (cock) standing on a wooden perch in an outdoor setting. The bird has white and light brown plumage on its body, black tail feathers with some iridescence, and distinct red comb and wattles. It is facing left, with one leg visible and the other partially obscured. The background includes a reddish-brown wooden wall and stone structures.
